title: What's the weather like today?
objectives: ask and describe basic weather conditions
use weather adjectives with impersonal it is

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for What's the weather like today?.
Welcome to today's lesson: What's the weather like today?! Today we will practice how to ask and describe basic weather conditions.

elements.content: Lesson Objectives for What's the weather like today?:
ask and describe basic weather conditions; use weather adjectives with impersonal it is

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: weather, hot, cold, sunny, rainy, wind

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: It is cold and windy today. I like sunny weather when I have free time.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
What is the weather like today? It is sunny and hot. Yesterday it was cold and rainy.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe today's weather in your city and compare it to yesterday.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.
